description: JourneyBay helps travelers plan and manage trips from ChatGPT. Users can view upcoming trips, inspect day-by-day itineraries, search places, manage saved places, create and update trips, import itineraries planned in conversation, generate or adjust itineraries, retrieve visa information, and chat with the JourneyBay travel assistant.
